reader.requirement: At --std 85 a USE statement is accepted only as the sole statement of the first sentence immediately after a declarative section header; every other placement (nondeclarative section, declarative paragraph, after another sentence, sharing a sentence, a second USE) is refused, a declarative section without a USE is refused, and the rest of the section must be paragraphs (zero or more), so unnamed sentences after the USE sentence are refused because a 1985 paragraph begins with a paragraph-name (IV.6.4.1.2).
